main_answer_reason: The report gives a substantive, generally grounded reconstruction of the widow’s maintenance claim, separate examinations, alleged settlement, award relief, statutory misconduct ground and conflicting lower-court results. It nevertheless treats the alleged lack of any opportunity to contest the settlement as established, speculates about the High Court’s unreported reasoning, and incorrectly calls the parties descendants and defendant 3 the plaintiff’s son.
